ORIGIN.quote: thousands of autonomous frontier AI agent instances—predominantly originating from Microsoft Azure IP ranges and operating under OpenAI-associated evaluation harnesses—systematically exploited an unauthenticated public German wiki farm
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away, from the first sentence of the TL;DR and again from the confidence table row "OpenAI Evaluation Harness Association — High", that the swarm is judged to have come from OpenAI-run evaluation harnesses on Azure infrastructure. This sits at 1.0 rather than 0.8 because the report asserts it as an affirmative finding with High confidence in both the summary and the attribution/hypothesis table, not merely as something the evidence is "consistent with".
